title: Northern Yukian language
extract: Northern Yukian, also known as Ukomnoʼm, is an extinct language of California, formerly spoken by the Yuki people. The Yuki are the original inhabitants of the Eel River area and the Round Valley Reservation of northern California. Yuki ceased to be used as an everyday language in the early 20th century and its last native speaker, Arthur Anderson, died in 1983. Northern Yukian is generally thought to be distantly related to the Wappo language.
